description: Pre-distribution gate implementing the CAMPAIGN-COMPLETENESS Ground Zero invariant. Reads brain/identity/handles.md to derive canonical distribution surfaces, then verifies campaign.json accounts for every surface — either with a spoke or an explicit skip reason in meta.skip_surfaces. BLOCKs on silent omissions.
litmus: Run HOW.py with campaign_file — exit 0=all surfaces accounted for, exit 1=BLOCK (silent omission), exit 2=WARN (handles.md missing).

files.HOW.py: Surface coverage gate — derive surfaces from handles.md, check campaign accounts for all
files.AUDIT.py: Compliance audit — detect past silent-omission blocks at distribution time
files.WATCH.py: Evolution scanner — signal template_gap if omission rate exceeds 20%

skip_surfaces_convention: Document intentional skips in campaign.json: meta.skip_surfaces = {"reddit": "no image asset ready"}
origin_incident: 2026-04-23 jury-beats-judge Part-2: Instagram and Facebook entirely missed — no spoke, no skip reason, no documentation. Gate built to enforce CAMPAIGN-COMPLETENESS invariant.
